description: Claude Code と Copilot CLI の OTLP テレメトリ (Mimir / Loki / Tempo) をまとめて見るダッシュボード。上部の Agent で切り替える

panels.description: Claude のアカウント週次上限に対する使用率。statusline hook が headroom の subscription-window から取って push する値 (job=claude-statusline) で、アカウント全体の値なので $agent の絞り込みは掛けていない
panels.title: 7d 使用率

panels.description: 表示期間内に消費した全トークン。Claude Code は counter、Copilot CLI は gen_ai.client.token.usage ヒストグラムの sum から算出する

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))

panels.title: トークン

panels.description: 起動したセッション数 (fresh / resume の合計)
panels.title: セッション

panels.title: 作業時間

panels.description: 全トークンに占める cacheRead の割合。高いほどプロンプトキャッシュが効いている

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range])))

panels.description: skill を使わなかった消費は除外している

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: skill 別コスト (上位 10)

panels.description: skill が有効な間に発生した api_request の件数であって、skill の起動回数ではない。起動回数を持つ skill_activated イベントは自作 skill が custom_skill に潰れて使えないため、この軸を採っている
panels.title: skill 別の API リクエスト数 (上位 10)

panels.description: skill から委譲した subagent の消費にも親の skill_name が付く。並び順は skill 名の昇順で、コスト順に見たいときは右の明細テーブルを使う

targets.expr: ((sum by (skill_name, caller) (label_replace(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | agent_name = "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]), "caller", "main", "skill_name", ".+"))) or (sum by (skill_name, caller) (label_replace(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | agent_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]), "caller", "subagent", "skill_name", ".+")))) and on (skill_name) topk(10, sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: main / subagent 別コスト (上位 10)

panels.description: 上位 10 で切らず全 skill を並べる。subagent 比率は委譲の重い skill を示す

targets.expr: sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

(sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | agent_name = "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or (sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 0))

(sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | agent_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or (sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 0))

(sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | agent_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or (sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$agent"} | event_name = "api_request" | skill_name != "" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
